items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play Monday vs Cowboys; DeVonta Smith out.
items.why: Returned to practice after hamstring; coach/report expected.
items.implication: Immediate RB1 reinstall vs soft Cowboys run D if active.
items.opportunity: Full workload likely; handcuff Gainwell drops.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Goedert and remaining WRs (A.J. Brown if active context) funnel more targets; Saquon still expected.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert TE1 upside elevated; reverse Smith starts.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice but ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley start tanks Ravens pass game upside; Flowers/Andrews/Henry volume shifts possible but lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Reverse any Huntley fades if Lamar had played; monitor Ravens skill usage.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: Q Lamar/Puka/Breece/Baker/Dowdle/Mason/Kirk/Dell etc; OUT Evans/Deebo/Adams/Rice/Love/Montgomery/Egbuka/Warren/Charbonnet/BRob; IN Jacobs/Judkins/Addison/Hockenson/Bateman.
items.implication: Direct opps: Bijan full with BRob OUT; TE funnel SF/LAR; Jacobs back.
items.opportunity: Parse every status change for beneficiaries (e.g. Bijan, Kittle, Higbee).

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.implication: Lead back returns; monitor snap share post-layoff vs tough Lions.
items.opportunity: Workload question after absence; Lloyd/Johnson poor backups noted.

items.text: If Saquon active vs Cowboys or Breece vs Dolphins, both go right back in lineups (Stephania more cautious on Breece).
items.opportunity: Monitor final status; full roles expected.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: Higbee lead, then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell/Whittington/Allen. McVay: minor, pregame test, lacked power/explosion.
items.why: Calf felt mid-practice Thursday; majority Thursday but missed Friday.
items.implication: TE-heavy if out (prior 37% TE share without him/Adams); Higbee primary.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK (thank Caleb): 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games since Williams return.
items.implication: Strong TE start; every-week TE1 upside.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). 49ers D concedes RB catches (recent White/Holani/Harvey/Love); DvP +4.4% RB production (7th). Sweet full setup for Bijan.
items.why: BRob ruled out; SF soft vs RB receiving.
items.implication: Bijan bellcow + pass-catch upside vs SF.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: awesome scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo out). Ignore 'National TE Day' narrative.
items.why: WR injuries force funnel to Kittle/CMC.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets spike; CMC slot temptation noted separately.

items.text: A.J. Brown LOVE: 97% routes, 33% TS (led team) Week 6 despite 3 catches/3 drops/27 yds on 10 targets. Buying the usage.
items.opportunity: High routes + share in good matchup.

items.text: Rarely buy RB-as-WR claims, but SF dire WR situation + Kaelon Black presence tempts buy on CMC more slot this week. CMC smiled at question.
items.opportunity: Slot snaps if true; still primary RB.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks. Downgrade.
Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-sets, giving more juice.
items.implication: Breakout candidate with higher route share.
